map.泡水（痕迹/霉味）检测 使用指南: Water Damage (Traces / Mold Odor) Test User Guide
map.二手车泡水车检测清单，逐项检查内饰霉味、水渍痕迹、泥沙堆积、锈蚀异常等15项泡水: Used-car flood damage inspection checklist — check interior mold odor, water stain traces, silt buildup, abnormal rust and 15 flood indicators item by item to judge the flood risk level
map.购车前按 15 项泡水指标逐项筛查：内饰霉味、水渍痕迹、泥沙堆积、金属锈蚀异常等: Before buying a car, screen the 15 flood indicators one by one: interior mold odor, water stain traces, silt buildup, abnormal metal rust and so on.
map.对「确认泡水」与「疑似泡水」项分别标记，量化泡水风险等级。: Mark "confirmed flood damage" and "suspected flood damage" items separately to quantify the flood risk level.
map.将检测结果作为是否进场深度检测（如地毯下、线束）的决策依据。: Use the results to decide whether deeper inspection is warranted on entry (e.g. under carpet, in the wiring harness).
map.以「内饰霉味、座椅滑轨泥沙、安全带根部水渍均确认」为例: Taking "interior mold odor, silt on the seat rails, water stains at the seatbelt root all confirmed" as an example
map.：15 项指标逐项按权重计分，勾选「确认泡水」(值=2) 的项计入 confir: : the 15 indicators are scored item by item by weight; items ticked "confirmed flood damage" (value=2) enter the confirmed list and add their weight, while "suspected" (value=1) adds to suspicious. If the confirmed items cluster in the interior and metal parts, the total falls in the high-risk band and the car is judged "high flood risk" — strongly consider walking away or a deep teardown; if only isolated suspicions remain, judge low risk and recommend recheck.
map.确认项和疑似项权重一样吗？: Do confirmed and suspected items carry the same weight?
map.计分按勾选值×项目权重累加（确认=2、疑似=1），因此确认项的贡献是疑似项的 2: Scoring accumulates ticked value × item weight (confirmed=2, suspected=1), so a confirmed item contributes twice a suspected one; the confirmed list is also shown separately so hard faults are visible at a glance. The final risk grade is set by the total-score threshold.
map.判定为泡水风险高就一定是泡水车吗？: Does a high flood risk rating mean the car is definitely flood-damaged?
map.不一定。个别指标（如雨天进水、洗车残留）可能误报，但多项确认指标同时命中时概率极: Not necessarily. Individual indicators (such as water ingress in rain, detergent residue) can give false positives, but when several confirming indicators hit at once the probability is very high. Conclusions are risk prompts only; legal and transaction determinations require a report from a qualified appraisal institution.
